Deployment Guide"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Accurately remember user and task context and reuse it across agents; evolve memory through ongoing "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"interactions, automatically distill Skills, and connect with file-based knowledge systems so experie"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"nce truly becomes capability."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> ⭐ **Star us on GitHub to automatically upgrade to a Pro quota membership.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 📰 News"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **2026-10-31**: Multimodal memory is here — `memory.add` / `memory.search` accept images (original"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"s stored in S3-compatible object storage / MinIO, indexed by multimodal embeddings), with `enhanced`"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" mode adding VLM visual-fact extraction and multimodal agent retrieval. Benchmark results and the ru"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"n guide: the multimodal section of the evaluation guide.
- **2026-08-18**: We released the DeepSeek "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"Harness Plugin, letting DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agents automatically recall and write MindMemOS memor"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ies.
- **2026-08-14**: We released the MindMemOS 1.0 technical report, *MindMemOS: A Portable and Se"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"lf-Evolving Memory Operating Layer for AI Agents*.
- **2026-07-17**: MindMemOS integrated with LLM4A"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"D_NEXT, providing searchable long-term memory for algorithm design tasks and enabling the accumulati"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"on and reuse of cross-task experience, domain knowledge, and constraints.
- **2026-06-30**: MindMemO"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"S was officially released!"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 🌟 Core Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Portable across agents**: Persist user profiles, preferences, project facts, tool experience, an"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"d skill candidates as reusable assets, allowing OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, OpenHands, and other "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"agents to share or transfer the same long-term memory.
- **Self-evolving memory system**: Continuous"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ly improve memory quality through schema learning, dreaming, and feedback by automatically learning "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"frequent memory patterns, consolidating memories offline, and using interaction corrections to optim"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ize add/search workflows.
- **Multimodal memory**: Images ride alongside text in vanilla `add`/`sear"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ch` under `algo_config.multimodal.mode` (`off`/`basic`/`enhanced`, per-project overridable) — store "},{"id":"p8s8","text":"originals in S3/MinIO (the only image backend), index them with a multimodal embedding model (`mm_em"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"bed_model_router`, SigLIP2-compatible), and in `enhanced` extract visual facts with a VLM and retrie"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ve through a multimodal agent. Image hits carry `metadata.image_url` — a permanent mirror URL when c"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"onfigured, else a short-lived presigned URL on S3/MinIO, else an equally short-lived signed proxy UR"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"L that needs no API key — plus `metadata.blob_id` for re-download. Disabled by default (`off`), with"},{"id":"p8s13","text":" byte-identical text-only behavior.
- **Memory and Skills integration**: Experience memories can be "},{"id":"p8s14","text":"distilled into skill candidates, while skill execution results, failure traces, and user feedback fl"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"ow back into the memory system to drive continuous skill evolution.
- **Plugin integrations**: Conne"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"ct MindMemOS to different agents and workflows through plugins that retrieve and inject relevant mem"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"ories before interactions and automatically write conversations back afterward. The OpenClaw Plugin "},{"id":"p8s18","text":"and DeepSeek Harness Plugin are currently available, with more integrations in progress."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 🚀 Quick Start"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"MindMemOS offers **two deployment modes** (official cloud service, local self-hosting) and **three a"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ccess methods** (HTTP API, Python SDK / CLI, agent plugin). Any combination works — server and clien"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"t speak the same protocol:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Access Method | Use Case | Cloud base_url | Local base_url |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| HTTP "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"API | Call directly from business apps | `https://mindmemos.cn` | `http://127.0.0.1:8000` |
| Python"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" SDK / CLI | Integrate into business apps | `https://mindmemos.cn` | `http://127.0.0.1:8000` |
| Ope"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"nClaw Plugin | Agent auto-recalls / writes memory | `https://mindmemos.cn` | `http://127.0.0.1:8000`"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" |
| DeepSeek Harness Plugin | Agent auto-recalls / writes memory (dsh) | `https://mindmemos.cn` | `"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"http://127.0.0.1:8000` |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"To try it without deploying, use the official cloud service (request an API key on the website); for"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" on-premises or offline use, start with Local Deployment below."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 1. Local Deployment"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"MindMemOS uses `uv` to manage dependencies and run local commands. For detailed configuration instru"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ctions, see docs/deploy/instruction.md."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"#### 1.1 Prepare Configuration Files"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Before startup, configure at least the following three model routers in `config/mindmemos/dev.yaml`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- `chat_model_router`: supports memory extraction, Skill evolution, and other generation tasks.
- `e"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"mbed_model_router`: generates semantic embeddings; make sure its dimensions match the Qdrant dimensi"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"on configuration.
- `rerank_model_router`: optional; reranks memory retrieval results."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The schema memory-extraction flow is versioned: `algo_config.add.schema.version` defaults to `v2` (r"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ule-based graph fusion) and can be pinned to `v1` (develop-compatible flow) per project. Storage is "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"compatible in both directions; see the deployment guide for binding and effective timing."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Configure an API key and its bound `project_id` in `config/mindmemos/api_keys.yaml`."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"#### 1.2 Start the Service"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Start the local service:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`make dev` starts the full Docker dependency stack before starting FastAPI."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"To start only core dependencies:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### 2. Access Methods"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Cloud and local self-hosting use the same access protocol. Local keys come from `config/mindmemos/ap"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"i_keys.yaml`; cloud keys are obtained from the website."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## 🗺️ Coming Features"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Lite mode**: Designed around low dependencies, replaceable components, and easy embedding, with "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"database backends, async tasks, and log storage decoupled into flexible lightweight components that "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"support in-memory calls and simplified deployment.
- **Skills system**: Govern large and redundant s"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"kill libraries and distribute them intelligently; continuously evolve and optimize skills based on r"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"eal usage; automatically synthesize new skills from frequent user scenarios and refine them through "},{"id":"p31s6","text":"offline simulation.
- **File system memory**: Structure scattered knowledge from local files, docume"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"nts, project artifacts, and agent outputs into searchable and connected file knowledge objects or kn"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"owledge graphs, helping agents complete user tasks more effectively.
- **Agent integrations**: Conti"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"nue expanding support for coding agents, OpenClaw, Codex-style workflows, and long-running multi-age"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"ng support for coding agents, OpenClaw, Codex-style workflows, and long-running multi-agent systems."}],"truncated":true}
